cn.title: Computer Networks
cn.examFormat: Part A: 8 questions x 3 marks = 24 marks (all compulsory). Part B: 4 modules x 9 marks = 36 marks (choice per module). Total = 60 marks (2.5 Hrs).

modules.name: Module 1: Internet Architecture & Application Layer

topics.title: Overview of the Internet & Protocol Layering
topics.concepts: Network edge, core, packet vs circuit switching, 5-layer Internet stack, encapsulation & decapsulation principles.

topics.title: Application Layer Paradigms & Client-Server Architecture
topics.concepts: Socket interface, addressing processes, transport service requirements (data loss, throughput, timing, security).

topics.title: World Wide Web and HTTP (HTTP/1.0, 1.1)
topics.concepts: Persistent vs non-persistent HTTP, RTT calculation, HTTP request/response message formats, status codes, cookies, web caching.

topics.title: File Transfer Protocol (FTP)
topics.concepts: Control connection (port 21) vs data connection (port 20), out-of-band control, stateful FTP connection.

topics.title: Electronic Mail Architecture & Protocols (SMTP, POP3, IMAP)
topics.concepts: User agents, mail servers, SMTP transfer protocol, message formats, comparison of pull protocols (POP3, IMAP, HTTP).

topics.title: Domain Name System (DNS)
topics.concepts: Distributed hierarchical database (Root, TLD, Authoritative, Local), iterative vs recursive queries, caching, DNS resource records (A, NS, CNAME, MX).

topics.title: Peer-to-Peer (P2P) Paradigm & BitTorrent Case Study
topics.concepts: Client-Server vs P2P file distribution time comparison, BitTorrent torrents, trackers, choking/unchoking algorithms, tit-for-tat.

modules.name: Module 2: Transport Layer & Network Layer

topics.title: Transport Layer Services & Multiplexing/Demultiplexing
topics.concepts: Process-to-process delivery, port numbers, connectionless vs connection-oriented demultiplexing.

topics.title: User Datagram Protocol (UDP)
topics.concepts: UDP segment header structure (8 bytes), checksum calculation using 1s complement sum, pseudo-header, use cases.

topics.title: TCP Segment Structure & Connection Management
topics.concepts: TCP header fields, sequence and acknowledgment numbers, 3-way handshake (SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK), connection termination (FIN/ACK).

topics.title: TCP Flow Control & Congestion Control
topics.concepts: Receive window (rwnd), Stop-and-Wait, sliding window, AIMD, Slow Start threshold (ssthresh), Congestion Avoidance, Fast Retransmit, Fast Recovery.

topics.title: Linux Socket Programming (TCP & UDP Sockets)
topics.concepts: Socket API: socket(), bind(), listen(), accept(), connect(), send()/recv(), sendto()/recvfrom(), I/O Multiplexing (select, poll).

topics.title: Network Layer Introduction, IPv4 Addressing & Subnetting
topics.concepts: Data plane vs Control plane, IPv4 header format, Classful vs Classless addressing (CIDR), subnet masks, subnetting numericals, NAT.

topics.title: Unicast Routing Algorithms (Distance Vector & Link State)
topics.concepts: Bellman-Ford algorithm & Count-to-Infinity problem; Dijkstra Link State algorithm & step-by-step routing table construction, OSPF, BGP.

topics.title: Multicast Routing, IPv6 & Quality of Service (QoS)
topics.concepts: Multicast basics, IPv6 header format (fixed 40 bytes) vs IPv4, dual stack and tunneling, QoS traffic shaping (Leaky Bucket vs Token Bucket).

topics.title: Linux Kernel Routing Table & IP Command
topics.concepts: Kernel routing cache overview, manipulating routing entries using ip route add/del.

modules.name: Module 3: Data-Link Layer & Local Area Networks

topics.title: Data Link Control (DLC) & Framing Techniques
topics.concepts: Framing: Character count, Byte stuffing (character stuffing with flag bytes), Bit stuffing (flag 01111110 with zero-insertion).

topics.title: Error Detection & Correction (CRC, Checksum, Hamming Code)
topics.concepts: CRC polynomial division with generator, Checksum 1s complement, Hamming code parity bit positioning (^k \ge m + k + 1$), single-bit correction.

topics.title: Flow & Error Control ARQ Protocols
topics.concepts: Stop-and-Wait ARQ, Go-Back-N ARQ (window size $, ^m - 1$), Selective Repeat ARQ (window size ^{m-1}$), efficiency calculations.

topics.title: Multiple Access Protocols (MAC)
topics.concepts: Pure ALOHA (throughput  = G e^{-2G}$, 18.4%), Slotted ALOHA ( = G e^{-G}$, 36.8%), 1-persistent/non-persistent/p-persistent CSMA, CSMA/CD binary exponential backoff.

topics.title: Link-Layer Addressing & ARP Protocol
topics.concepts: 48-bit MAC addresses, ARP packet format, ARP request (broadcast) and reply (unicast), ARP cache table.

topics.title: Ethernet Protocol & Network Connecting Devices
topics.concepts: Standard Ethernet 802.3 frame structure, Hubs, Switches (learning bridges, frame filtering/forwarding), Spanning Tree Protocol (STP), Routers.

topics.title: Wireless LANs (IEEE 802.11) & Mobile IP
topics.concepts: BSS, ESS, AP, CSMA/CA protocol, Hidden terminal problem & Exposed terminal problem, RTS/CTS exchange, Mobile IP home/foreign agents, triangular routing.

modules.name: Module 4: Network Management & Physical Layer

topics.title: Network Management Architecture & SNMP
topics.concepts: Manager/Agent model, SNMP protocol (GetRequest, SetRequest, Trap), SMI data definition rules, MIB object tree hierarchy, ASN.1 encoding.

topics.title: Physical Layer Data, Signals & Transmission Impairments
topics.concepts: Analog vs digital signals, composite signals, bandwidth, attenuation, distortion, noise, SNR, Nyquist formula (B \log_2 L$), Shannon capacity ( \log_2(1 + SNR)$).

topics.title: Digital Transmission & Line Coding Schemes
topics.concepts: Unipolar, Polar (NRZ-L, NRZ-I, RZ, Manchester, Differential Manchester), Bipolar (AMI, B8ZS, HDB3), DC component, synchronization, baseline wander.

topics.title: Analog-to-Digital Conversion (PCM & Delta Modulation)
topics.concepts: Sampling (Nyquist theorem:  \ge 2 f_{max}$), Quantization, Quantization error, Encoding, Pulse Code Modulation (PCM), Delta Modulation (DM), slope overload noise.

topics.title: Analog Transmission & Digital Modulation (ASK, FSK, PSK, QAM)
topics.concepts: Amplitude Shift Keying (ASK), Frequency Shift Keying (FSK), Binary Phase Shift Keying (BPSK), Quadrature PSK (QPSK), constellation diagrams, QAM.

topics.title: Bandwidth Utilization (Multiplexing & Spread Spectrum)
topics.concepts: Frequency-Division Multiplexing (FDM), Wave-Division Multiplexing (WDM), Time-Division Multiplexing (Synchronous vs Statistical TDM), FHSS, DSSS.

topics.title: Transmission Media (Guided & Unguided Media)
topics.concepts: Twisted pair (UTP Cat5/6), Coaxial cable, Fiber optic cable (Single mode vs Multimode step/graded index, total internal reflection, critical angle), Radio/Microwave/IR.

daa.title: Design and Analysis of Algorithms
daa.examFormat: Part A: 8 questions x 3 marks = 24 marks (all compulsory). Part B: 4 modules x 9 marks = 36 marks (choice per module). Total = 60 marks (2.5 Hrs).

modules.name: Module 1: Complexity Analysis, Recurrences & Balanced Trees

topics.title: Algorithms, Characteristics & Performance Analysis
topics.concepts: Algorithm criteria, time and space complexity, best, worst, and average case complexities, complexity calculation of non-recursive loops.

topics.title: Asymptotic Notations and Their Mathematical Properties
topics.concepts: Definitions of Big-O, Big-Omega, Big-Theta, Little-o, Little-omega, formal limit definitions, transitivity, reflexivity, symmetry properties.

topics.title: Solving Recurrences: Iteration & Substitution Methods
topics.concepts: Formulating recurrences from recursive code, unrolling/backward substitution, mathematical induction method for proving upper/lower bounds.

topics.title: Solving Recurrences: Recursion Tree & Master Theorem
topics.concepts: Recursion tree level-by-level work evaluation; Master Theorem cases 1, 2, 3 for (n) = aT(n/b) + f(n)$ and extended master theorem cases.

topics.title: Balanced Search Trees: AVL Trees & Rotations
topics.concepts: AVL tree definition, balance factor BF = height(left) - height(right), single rotations (LL, RR), double rotations (LR, RL), step-by-step insertions and deletions.

modules.name: Module 2: Disjoint Sets, Graph Algorithms & Divide-and-Conquer

topics.title: Disjoint Sets: Union and Find Algorithms
topics.concepts: MakeSet, FindSet, Union operations, tree representation, Union by Rank, Path Compression heuristics, connected components of an undirected graph.

topics.title: Graph Representations & Traversals (BFS, DFS)
topics.concepts: Adjacency matrix vs list, BFS algorithm (queue, shortest paths in unweighted graphs), DFS algorithm (stack/recursion, discovery and finishing times, edge classification).

topics.title: Strongly Connected Components (SCC) & Topological Sorting
topics.concepts: Kosaraju Algorithm (DFS, reverse graph, DFS on finishing times order), Topological Sorting of DAG using DFS / Kahn in-degree algorithm.

topics.title: Divide and Conquer Strategy: Control Abstraction & Merge Sort
topics.concepts: General divide-and-conquer recurrence, Merge Sort algorithm, merging step, recurrence (n) = 2T(n/2) + O(n)$, (n \log n)$ time complexity proof.

topics.title: Strassen Matrix Multiplication
topics.concepts: Traditional matrix multiplication (n^3)$ vs Strassen 7 multiplications, formula for $ to $, recurrence (n) = 7T(n/2) + O(n^2)$, time complexity (n^{2.81})$.

modules.name: Module 3: Greedy Strategy, Dynamic Programming & Backtracking

topics.title: Greedy Strategy & Fractional Knapsack Problem
topics.concepts: Greedy-choice property, optimal substructure, Fractional Knapsack algorithm using profit/weight ratio sorting, comparison with 0/1 Knapsack.

topics.title: Minimum Cost Spanning Tree (Prim and Kruskal Algorithms)
topics.concepts: Prim algorithm using priority queue (E \log V)$, Kruskal algorithm using Disjoint Sets (E \log E)$, step-by-step trace on graphs, cut/cycle properties.

topics.title: Single Source Shortest Path: Dijkstra Algorithm
topics.concepts: Relaxation procedure, greedy vertex selection, Dijkstra algorithm step-by-step trace table, non-negative edge restriction, time complexity analysis.

topics.title: Dynamic Programming Principle & Matrix Chain Multiplication (MCM)
topics.concepts: Principle of Optimality, memoization vs tabulation, MCM recurrence [i,j] = \min(m[i,k] + m[k+1,j] + p_{i-1}p_k p_j)$, dynamic programming table construction.

topics.title: All-Pairs Shortest Path: Floyd-Warshall Algorithm
topics.concepts: Transitive closure, intermediate vertices dynamic recurrence ^{(k)}[i,j] = \min(D^{(k-1)}[i,j], D^{(k-1)}[i,k] + D^{(k-1)}[k,j])$, step-by-step matrix evaluation (n^3)$.

topics.title: Backtracking Strategy & N-Queens Problem
topics.concepts: State space tree, depth-first search with bounding/pruning function, 4-Queens and 8-Queens solution, place(k, i) bounding function.

modules.name: Module 4: Branch & Bound, Complexity Classes (P/NP) & Approximation

topics.title: Branch and Bound Strategy & Travelling Salesperson Problem (TSP)
topics.concepts: FIFO vs Least Cost (LC) Branch and Bound, reduced cost matrix calculation, state space tree expansion for TSP.

topics.title: Complexity Classes: P, NP, NP-Hard, and NP-Complete
topics.concepts: Tractable vs intractable problems, decision vs optimization, class P, class NP, polynomial reduction ( \le_p B$), Cook-Levin theorem, Venn diagram.

topics.title: NP-Completeness Proofs: Clique Problem & Vertex Cover
topics.concepts: Steps to prove a problem is NP-Complete, proving Vertex Cover is in NP, reducing 3-SAT to Clique, reducing Clique to Vertex Cover.

topics.title: Approximation Algorithms & Bin Packing Problem
topics.concepts: Approximation ratio, Next-Fit, First-Fit, Best-Fit, First-Fit Decreasing (FFD) heuristics, competitive ratio bounds.

topics.title: Randomized Algorithms (Monte Carlo & Las Vegas) & Randomized QuickSort
topics.concepts: Monte Carlo (bounded error, fixed time) vs Las Vegas (always correct, probabilistic time), Randomized QuickSort pivot selection, (n \log n)$ expected runtime.

dsa.title: Data Structures and Algorithms
dsa.examFormat: Part A: 8 questions x 3 marks = 24 marks (all compulsory). Part B: 4 modules x 9 marks = 36 marks (choice per module). Total = 60 marks (2.5 Hrs).

modules.name: Module 1: Linear Data Structures, Stacks & Queues

topics.title: Data Structures Concepts, Performance Analysis & Asymptotics
topics.concepts: Linear vs non-linear, ADT concept, Big-O, Big-Omega, Big-Theta definitions, space and time complexity estimation.

topics.title: Arrays, Polynomial Representation & Sparse Matrix
topics.concepts: Array representations, polynomial addition using arrays, sparse matrix 3-tuple format, simple transpose and fast transpose algorithms.

topics.title: Stacks: Array Implementation & Multiple Stacks
topics.concepts: Stack ADT, LIFO principle, Push, Pop, Peek, IsEmpty, IsFull operations, multiple stacks sharing single 1D array.

topics.title: Stack Applications: Infix to Postfix Conversion & Evaluation
topics.concepts: Operator precedence and associativity, step-by-step conversion algorithm using stack table, evaluation of postfix expression using operand stack.

topics.title: Queues: Linear, Circular, and Double-Ended Queues (Deque)
topics.concepts: Queue ADT, FIFO principle, limitation of linear queue, circular queue arithmetic (front/rear modulo N), input/output restricted deques.

modules.name: Module 2: Linked Lists & Memory Management

topics.title: Singly Linked List (SLL) Implementation & Operations
topics.concepts: Node structure, dynamic memory, insertion (head, tail, arbitrary position), deletion (head, tail, by key), search, traversal algorithms.

topics.title: Stacks, Queues & Polynomials using Linked Lists
topics.concepts: Linked stack (Push/Pop at head), Linked queue (Enqueue at tail, Dequeue at head), Polynomial representation and addition using linked list.

topics.title: Doubly Linked List (DLL) & Circular Linked List (CLL)
topics.concepts: DLL node (prev, data, next), bidirectional traversal, insertion/deletion; CLL header node, single circular and double circular lists.

topics.title: Dynamic Memory Allocation Schemes & Garbage Collection
topics.concepts: malloc, calloc, realloc, free; First-fit, Best-fit, Worst-fit allocation strategies with numerical comparison, internal/external fragmentation, compaction.

modules.name: Module 3: Trees, Binary Heaps & Graphs

topics.title: Tree Concepts & Binary Trees (Types & Properties)
topics.concepts: Degree, height, depth, full, complete, perfect binary trees, maximum nodes at level i (^i$), array vs linked representation.

topics.title: Binary Tree Traversals (Inorder, Preorder, Postorder, Level-order)
topics.concepts: Recursive traversal algorithms, trace on tree, tree reconstruction given Inorder + Preorder or Inorder + Postorder; Expression trees.

topics.title: Binary Search Trees (BST) & Operations
topics.concepts: BST property, search algorithm (h)$, insertion, deletion (leaf, 1 child, 2 children using inorder predecessor/successor).

topics.title: Binary Heaps (Max-Heap, Min-Heap) & Priority Queues
topics.concepts: Heap property, array representation (i+1, 2i+2$), Insert operation, Delete/Extract-Max, Heapify procedure, Priority Queue ADT.

topics.title: Graphs: Representations & Traversals (BFS, DFS)
topics.concepts: Adjacency matrix, adjacency list, BFS using queue, DFS using stack/recursion, single-source shortest path concept in unweighted graphs.

modules.name: Module 4: Sorting & Searching Techniques & Hashing

topics.title: Comparison-Based Sorting: Selection, Insertion, Bubble Sort
topics.concepts: Algorithms, pass-by-pass tracing, best/average/worst case time complexities, space complexity, stability comparison.

topics.title: Advanced Sorting: Quick Sort & Merge Sort
topics.concepts: Quick Sort partition algorithm (pivot placement, worst-case (n^2)$, average (n \log n)$); Merge Sort algorithm, merging procedure, guaranteed (n \log n)$.

topics.title: Heap Sort & Radix Sort
topics.concepts: Heap Sort in-place algorithm (build max-heap, swap root with last, heapify, (n \log n)$); Radix Sort LSD bucket pass using counting sort.

topics.title: Searching Techniques: Linear Search & Binary Search
topics.concepts: Linear search algorithm, Binary search (iterative and recursive versions), precondition of sorted array, (\log n)$ comparison.

topics.title: Hashing, Hash Functions & Collision Resolution
topics.concepts: Hash functions (Division, Mid-Square, Folding, Digit Analysis); Collision resolution: Open Addressing (Linear Probing, Quadratic Probing, Double Hashing) vs Chaining, load factor.

mat.title: S3 Mathematics (Probability & Random Processes)
mat.examFormat: Part A: 8 questions x 3 marks = 24 marks (all compulsory). Part B: 4 modules x 9 marks = 36 marks (choice per module). Total = 60 marks (2.5 Hrs).

modules.name: Module 1: Discrete Random Variables & Distributions

topics.title: Discrete Random Variables & PMF/CDF
topics.concepts: Discrete random variables, Probability Mass Function (PMF), Cumulative Distribution Function (CDF) and its properties.

topics.title: Mathematical Expectation, Mean & Variance
topics.concepts: Expected value E[X], Variance Var(X) = E[X^2] - (E[X])^2, standard deviation, properties of expectation and variance.

topics.title: Binomial Probability Distribution
topics.concepts: Bernoulli trials, Binomial PMF P(X=k) = nCk p^k (1-p)^(n-k), Mean = np, Variance = np(1-p), moment generating functions.

topics.title: Poisson Probability Distribution
topics.concepts: Poisson PMF P(X=k) = e^(-lambda) lambda^k / k!, Mean = lambda, Variance = lambda, Poisson as limiting form of Binomial distribution (n -> inf, p -> 0).

topics.title: Two-Dimensional Discrete Random Variables
topics.concepts: Joint probability mass function P(X=x, Y=y), Marginal PMFs of X and Y, Condition for independence P(X,Y) = P(X)P(Y), Expected value E[g(X,Y)].

modules.name: Module 2: Continuous Random Variables & Distributions

topics.title: Continuous Random Variables & PDF/CDF
topics.concepts: Probability Density Function (PDF) f(x) >= 0, integral of f(x) = 1, relationship between PDF and CDF dF(x)/dx = f(x), Expectation, Mean and Variance.

topics.title: Uniform Distribution
topics.concepts: Uniform continuous distribution on [a, b], PDF f(x) = 1/(b-a), CDF, Mean = (a+b)/2, Variance = (b-a)^2 / 12.

topics.title: Normal (Gaussian) Distribution
topics.concepts: Bell-shaped curve, standard normal distribution Z = (X - mu)/sigma, standard normal tables, 68-95-99.7 empirical rule, properties and applications.

topics.title: Exponential Distribution & Memoryless Property
topics.concepts: PDF f(x) = lambda e^(-lambda x), CDF F(x) = 1 - e^(-lambda x), Mean = 1/lambda, Variance = 1/lambda^2, Proof of Memoryless Property P(X > s+t | X > s) = P(X > t).

topics.title: Two-Dimensional Continuous Random Variables
topics.concepts: Joint PDF f(x,y), Marginal PDFs f_X(x) and f_Y(y), Independent continuous variables, Expectation E[g(X,Y)], Covariance.

modules.name: Module 3: Limit Theorems & Stochastic Processes

topics.title: Markov Inequality & Chebyshev Inequality
topics.concepts: Markov Inequality P(X >= a) <= E[X]/a for non-negative X; Chebyshev Inequality P(|X - mu| >= k*sigma) <= 1/k^2, bounding probabilities.

topics.title: Law of Large Numbers & Central Limit Theorem
topics.concepts: Weak and Strong Law of Large Numbers (SLLN statement); Central Limit Theorem (CLT) statement and solving probability approximations for sample sums.

topics.title: Stochastic Processes Classification
topics.concepts: Definition {X(t), t in T}, State space and Parameter space, classification: Discrete-time discrete-state, Discrete-time continuous-state, Continuous-time discrete-state, Continuous-time continuous-state.

topics.title: The Poisson Process & Interarrival Times
topics.concepts: Counting processes, Poisson process postulates (independent increments, stationary increments), distribution of number of arrivals, Exponential distribution of interarrival times.

modules.name: Module 4: Markov Chains & Random Walk Model

topics.title: Markov Chains & Transition Probability Matrix (TPM)
topics.concepts: Markov property P(X_n+1 = j | X_n = i), 1-step Transition Probability Matrix P, State transition diagram.

topics.title: Chapman-Kolmogorov Equations & n-Step Transitions
topics.concepts: P_ij^(n+m) = sum(P_ik^(n) * P_kj^(m)), calculating n-step transition probability matrix P^(n) by matrix multiplication.

topics.title: Classification of States in Markov Chains
topics.concepts: Accessible state, Communicating states, Closed set, Irreducible Markov chain, Recurrent state (first return probability f_ii = 1), Transient state (f_ii < 1), Periodic vs Aperiodic states, Absorbing states.

topics.title: Random Walk Model & Gambler Ruin Concept
topics.concepts: Simple 1D random walk on integers, absorbing barriers, transition probabilities, probability of ruin.

topics.title: Steady-State Distribution & Long-Run Proportions
topics.concepts: Stationary distribution vector pi = [pi_0, pi_1, ...], solving system of linear equations pi * P = pi and sum(pi_i) = 1 for long-run proportions.

ml.title: Machine Learning
ml.examFormat: Part A: 8 questions x 3 marks = 24 marks (all compulsory). Part B: 4 modules x 9 marks = 36 marks (choice per module). Total = 60 marks (2.5 Hrs).

modules.name: Module 1: ML Foundations, Paradigms & Parameter Estimation

topics.title: Machine Learning vs Traditional Programming
topics.concepts: Well-posed learning problem (Task T, Performance P, Experience E), ML workflow, supervised, unsupervised, semi-supervised, and reinforcement learning paradigms.

topics.title: Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE)
topics.concepts: Likelihood function L(theta), Log-likelihood, maximizing likelihood, MLE for coin-toss Bernoulli and Gaussian distribution parameters.

topics.title: Maximum A Posteriori (MAP) & Bayesian Formulation
topics.concepts: Bayes theorem for parameters P(theta|D) = P(D|theta)P(theta)/P(D), Prior vs Posterior distribution, comparison of MLE and MAP estimation.

topics.title: Feature Representation & Loss Functions
topics.concepts: Feature vectors, design matrix, role of loss functions (Mean Squared Error, Cross-Entropy loss) and optimization concepts.

modules.name: Module 2: Regression & Supervised Classification

topics.title: Linear Regression (Single & Multiple Variables)
topics.concepts: Hypothesis h_theta(x) = theta^T x, MSE Cost function J(theta), derivation of Gradient Descent update rules, Normal Equation closed-form solution theta = (X^T X)^(-1) X^T y.

topics.title: Logistic Regression & Sigmoid Function
topics.concepts: Classification problem, Sigmoid/Logistic activation g(z) = 1/(1 + e^(-z)), Log-Loss / Cross-Entropy cost function, decision boundary, gradient descent update.

topics.title: Naïve Bayes Classification
topics.concepts: Bayes rule for classification, Class conditional independence assumption, MAP decision rule, handling continuous features with Gaussian Naive Bayes.

topics.title: K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) Classifier
topics.concepts: Instance-based / Lazy learning, Distance metrics (Euclidean, Manhattan), choosing optimal k, boundary decisions, Voronoi diagram.

topics.title: Decision Trees & ID3 Algorithm
topics.concepts: Decision tree representation, Entropy H(S) = -sum(p log2 p), Information Gain calculation Gain(S, A), ID3 algorithm step-by-step split.

modules.name: Module 3: Overfitting, SVM & Neural Networks

topics.title: Overfitting, Underfitting & Regularization (L1 & L2)
topics.concepts: Overfitting causes, Training/Validation/Testing split, L1 LASSO (sparsity) vs L2 RIDGE (weight decay) regularization penalties in cost function.

topics.title: Evaluation Metrics for Classification & Regression
topics.concepts: Confusion Matrix (TP, TN, FP, FN), Precision, Recall, Accuracy, F1-Score, ROC curve and AUC; Regression: MAE, RMSE, R-squared coefficient.

topics.title: Support Vector Machines (Linear & Non-linear SVM)
topics.concepts: Hyperplane, Margin = 2/||w||, Maximum Margin Hyperplane, Support vectors, Hard margin vs Soft margin (slack variables), Kernel Trick (Polynomial, RBF Gaussian).

topics.title: Perceptron & Multilayer Feedforward Neural Networks
topics.concepts: Biological neuron vs Perceptron, activation functions (Sigmoid, ReLU, Tanh), Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) architecture, forward propagation.

topics.title: Backpropagation Algorithm
topics.concepts: Error backpropagation using chain rule, gradient of loss with respect to weights, weight update formula, learning rate.

modules.name: Module 4: Unsupervised Learning, Dimensionality Reduction & Ensembles

topics.title: Clustering Algorithms (K-Means & Hierarchical)
topics.concepts: Clustering similarity measures, K-Means algorithm (centroid update, convergence), Hierarchical Agglomerative Clustering (Single, Complete, Average linkage, Dendrograms).

topics.title: Principal Component Analysis (PCA)
topics.concepts: Curse of dimensionality, PCA steps: Mean centering, Covariance matrix calculation, Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors, projecting onto top k principal components.

topics.title: Ensemble Methods (Bagging & Boosting)
topics.concepts: Ensemble concept, Bootstrap Aggregation (Bagging, Random Forest), Boosting (Sequential training, AdaBoost algorithm, weighted errors).

topics.title: Resampling Methods & Bias-Variance Tradeoff
topics.concepts: K-Fold Cross Validation, Bootstrapping; Bias (underfitting) vs Variance (overfitting) tradeoff decomposition of expected test error.

mc.title: Microcontrollers & Embedded Systems
mc.examFormat: Part A: 8 questions x 3 marks = 24 marks (all compulsory). Part B: 4 modules x 9 marks = 36 marks (choice per module). Total = 60 marks (2.5 Hrs).

modules.name: Module 1: ARM Cortex-M Architecture

topics.title: Embedded Systems & Processor Classification
topics.concepts: Embedded systems characteristics, Embedded C basics, Microcontroller vs Microprocessor, Harvard vs Von Neumann, RISC vs CISC.

topics.title: ARM Cortex-M Series & Armv8-M Architecture
topics.concepts: ARM Cortex-M family overview, Cortex-M23 (efficiency) and Cortex-M33 (performance with TrustZone), Armv8-M Mainline vs Baseline architecture.

topics.title: ARM Cortex Core Features: Registers & Memory Map
topics.concepts: Core registers R0-R12, Stack Pointers MSP/PSP (R13), Link Register LR (R14), Program Counter PC (R15), Special registers xPSR, Memory-mapped I/O structure.

topics.title: Bus Architecture & Generational Comparison
topics.concepts: AMBA bus interface, AHB (Advanced High-performance Bus), APB (Advanced Peripheral Bus), comparison of Cortex-M33 with Cortex-M3/M4.

modules.name: Module 2: STM32 Peripheral Programming & Hardware Interfacing

topics.title: STM32 Architecture & HAL Library
topics.concepts: STM32U575 microcontroller specifications, Ultra-low power modes, STM32CubeIDE ecosystem, Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL) concepts and driver structure.

topics.title: GPIO Programming & Display Interfacing
topics.concepts: GPIO register configuration (MODER, OTYPER, OSPEEDR, PUPDR), LED blinking, 7-Segment display interfacing, 16x2 LCD display, Matrix Keypad scanning, Relay interfacing.

topics.title: Analog-to-Digital (ADC) & Digital-to-Analog (DAC) Conversion
topics.concepts: ADC successive approximation, interfacing Potentiometer, LDR, Temperature sensor; DAC configuration, generating sine wave and audio signals.

topics.title: Interrupt Handling (NVIC & EXTI)
topics.concepts: Nested Vectored Interrupt Controller (NVIC), Interrupt vector table, priority levels, External Interrupts (EXTI) configuration and ISR execution.

topics.title: Timers, Counters & Real-Time Clock (RTC)
topics.concepts: Basic timer configuration, prescaler and auto-reload registers (PSC, ARR), timers as event counters, RTC module and periodic time generation.

modules.name: Module 3: Serial Communication Protocols & USB

topics.title: UART / USART Serial Communication
topics.concepts: Asynchronous vs synchronous serial communication, baud rate calculation, frame format, TX/RX lines, interfacing STM32 to PC terminal via HAL UART.

topics.title: I2C Protocol & Sensor Interfacing
topics.concepts: Two-wire interface (SDA, SCL), master-slave addressing, START/STOP conditions, ACK/NACK, interfacing I2C temperature sensor and LCD.

topics.title: SPI Protocol & EEPROM Memory Interfacing
topics.concepts: Four-wire interface (MOSI, MISO, SCK, CS), full-duplex synchronous transmission, clock polarity (CPOL) and phase (CPHA), writing/reading SPI EEPROM.

topics.title: Controller Area Network (CAN) Protocol
topics.concepts: Differential signaling (CAN_H, CAN_L), message arbitration using CSMA/CD+AMP, CAN frame format, multi-node STM32 communication.

topics.title: USB Device Architecture & HID Implementation
topics.concepts: USB architecture, endpoints, descriptors, implementing USB Human Interface Device (HID) for keyboard/mouse emulation on STM32.

modules.name: Module 4: IoT, Wireless, FreeRTOS & TrustZone

topics.title: IoT Protocols (MQTT & CoAP) & Wireless Communication
topics.concepts: IoT architecture, MQTT publish/subscribe model, CoAP REST-based protocol; Interfacing GSM module (AT commands, SMS, GPRS), Bluetooth, and LoRa long-range.

topics.title: Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) & FreeRTOS Concepts
topics.concepts: General OS vs RTOS, Hard vs Soft real-time, FreeRTOS kernel on STM32, Task states, Task creation (xTaskCreate), Task priority and Preemptive Priority Scheduling.

topics.title: Inter-Task Communication: Queues & Semaphores
topics.concepts: Task synchronization, Binary semaphores, Counting semaphores, Mutex (priority inversion and priority inheritance), FreeRTOS Queues for message passing.

topics.title: ARM TrustZone Security Technology
topics.concepts: Hardware-enforced security, Secure World vs Non-Secure World, Secure Gateway, SAU (Security Attribution Unit), implementing TrustZone on STM32U575.

topics.title: Embedded Code & Memory Optimization Techniques
topics.concepts: RAM/Flash memory constraints, compiler optimization flags, debugging tools (JTAG, SWD), profiling and low-power software design.

da.title: Data Analytics
da.examFormat: Part A: 8 questions x 3 marks = 24 marks (all compulsory). Part B: 4 modules x 9 marks = 36 marks (choice per module). Total = 60 marks (2.5 Hrs).

modules.name: Module 1: Analytics Process Model & Proximity Measures

topics.title: Analytics Process Model & Data Analytics Lifecycle
topics.concepts: Data Analytics overview, business problem formulation, data collection, analytical model requirements, deployment lifecycle phases.

topics.title: Variable Types & Association Overview
topics.concepts: Discrete, continuous, and ordinal variables, probability calculus, common probability distributions in analytics.

topics.title: Hypothesis Testing Fundamentals
topics.concepts: Null hypothesis H0 vs Alternative hypothesis H1, Type I error (alpha) and Type II error (beta), p-value decision rule, significance level.

topics.title: Attribute Types & Proximity (Similarity / Dissimilarity) Measures
topics.concepts: Attribute types: Nominal, Binary (Symmetric vs Asymmetric), Ordinal, Numeric; Distance metrics: Euclidean, Manhattan, Minkowski, Cosine similarity for text.

modules.name: Module 2: Association of Variables & Descriptive Statistics

topics.title: Summarizing Two Discrete Variables & Contingency Tables
topics.concepts: Two-way contingency tables, Joint frequency, Marginal frequency, Conditional frequency distributions, mosaic display.

topics.title: Measures of Association for Discrete Variables
topics.concepts: Chi-Square (chi^2) test of independence, expected frequencies calculation, degrees of freedom (r-1)(c-1), Cramer V, Odds Ratio.

topics.title: Association: Ordinal and Continuous Variables
topics.concepts: Correlation between ordinal variables (Spearman rank correlation), continuous variables (Pearson correlation coefficient r), visualization across scales.

topics.title: Statistical Description: Central Tendency & Dispersion
topics.concepts: Mean, Median, Mode; Measures of dispersion: Range, Quartiles (Q1, Q2, Q3), Interquartile Range (IQR), Variance, Standard Deviation, Five-number summary, Boxplot.

modules.name: Module 3: Data Preprocessing, Frequent Patterns, Classification & Clustering

topics.title: Data Preprocessing Techniques
topics.concepts: Data Cleaning (missing values, noisy data smoothing), Integration, Reduction (numerosity, PCA), Transformation (Min-Max normalization, Z-score, Decimal scaling), Discretization.

topics.title: Mining Frequent Patterns & Apriori Algorithm
topics.concepts: Market basket analysis, Itemsets, Support and Confidence metrics, Apriori property (anti-monotonicity of support), candidate generation (Ck) and pruning (Lk) step-by-step.

topics.title: Classification: ID3 Decision Tree & Naïve Bayes
topics.concepts: Information Gain, Entropy, ID3 tree construction step-by-step; Naive Bayesian classification on tabular dataset.

topics.title: Clustering: K-Means, Hierarchical, BIRCH & DBSCAN
topics.concepts: K-Means clustering numerical; Agglomerative vs Divisive hierarchical; BIRCH clustering features; Density-based DBSCAN (core points, border points, noise points, eps, MinPts).

modules.name: Module 4: Text Processing & Information Retrieval

topics.title: Information Retrieval & Inverted Index Construction
topics.concepts: IR problem overview, Document representation, Inverted Index structure (dictionary and postings lists), processing Boolean queries (AND, OR, NOT).

topics.title: Text Preprocessing: Tokenization, Stemming & Positional Index
topics.concepts: Tokenization challenges, Stop word removal, Stemming (Porter stemmer rules) vs Lemmatization, Phrase queries and Positional index.

topics.title: Vector Space Model & TF-IDF Weighting
topics.concepts: Term Frequency (TF), Inverse Document Frequency (IDF = log(N/df)), TF-IDF weight matrix, Cosine similarity ranking between query and documents.

topics.title: Language Models & Naïve Bayes Text Classification
topics.concepts: Unigram and Bigram language models, Query likelihood model, Naive Bayes probabilistic text classification for spam/sentiment analysis.

ethics.title: Engineering Economics & Management
ethics.examFormat: Part A: 8 questions (compulsory). Part B: 4 module choices. Total = 50 Marks (CIE: 50, ESE: 50).

modules.name: Module 1: Basic Economics, Demand, Supply & Production

topics.title: Basic Economic Problems & Production Possibility Curve (PPC)
topics.concepts: Scarcity, choice, central problems (what, how, for whom), PPC definition, opportunity cost, law of increasing opportunity cost.

topics.title: Utility & Law of Diminishing Marginal Utility
topics.concepts: Total utility, marginal utility, law of diminishing marginal utility statement, assumptions, exceptions, and consumer equilibrium.

topics.title: Laws of Demand & Supply and Market Equilibrium
topics.concepts: Law of demand, demand curve, determinants of demand, exceptions; Law of supply; Market equilibrium and shifts in demand/supply curves.

topics.title: Elasticity of Demand & Applications
topics.concepts: Price elasticity, income elasticity, cross elasticity, degrees of elasticity (perfectly elastic, inelastic, unitary), measurement methods (point, arc), business applications.

topics.title: Production Function & Economies of Scale
topics.concepts: Short run vs long run, Law of Variable Proportions (3 stages of production), Internal and External economies of scale, Cobb-Douglas production function Q = A K^alpha L^beta.

modules.name: Module 2: Cost Concepts & Market Structures

topics.title: Cost Concepts & Short-Run Cost Curves
topics.concepts: Explicit vs Implicit cost, Social vs Private cost, Sunk cost, Opportunity cost, Fixed cost (TFC), Variable cost (TVC), Marginal cost (MC), Average cost (AC), U-shaped cost curves.

topics.title: Revenue Concepts & Objectives of Firms
topics.concepts: Total Revenue (TR), Average Revenue (AR), Marginal Revenue (MR), relationship between AR and MR under perfect and imperfect competition, profit maximization condition MR = MC.

topics.title: Market Structures: Perfect Competition & Monopoly
topics.concepts: Features of Perfect Competition, price taker, equilibrium; Monopoly: single seller, barriers to entry, price discrimination, equilibrium.

topics.title: Monopolistic Competition & Oligopoly
topics.concepts: Monopolistic competition: product differentiation, selling costs; Oligopoly: few sellers, mutual interdependence, price rigidity, Kinked Demand Curve hypothesis.

modules.name: Module 3: Monetary System, Taxation & National Income

topics.title: Functions of Money & Central Banking (RBI)
topics.concepts: Primary and secondary functions of money, Central Bank role, Quantitative credit control (Repo rate, Reverse repo, CRR, SLR, Bank rate) vs Qualitative credit controls.

topics.title: Inflation & Deflation: Causes, Effects & Policies
topics.concepts: Demand-pull inflation, Cost-push inflation, effects on production and distribution, Monetary policy vs Fiscal policy measures to control inflation.

topics.title: Taxation: Direct vs Indirect Taxes & GST
topics.concepts: Canons of taxation, Direct taxes (Income tax, Corporate tax) vs Indirect taxes (Customs, Excise), Goods and Services Tax (GST) structure, CGST, SGST, IGST.

topics.title: National Income Concepts & Circular Flow
topics.concepts: GDP, GNP, NNP at market price and factor cost, Personal income, Circular flow of income in two-sector and three-sector economies, difficulties in measurement.

topics.title: Stock Market Functions & Demat Trading
topics.concepts: Primary vs Secondary market, Functions of stock exchange, Demat account, Trading account, Stock market indices: BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty.

modules.name: Module 4: Value Engineering, Break-Even Analysis & Capital Budgeting

topics.title: Value Engineering: Concepts & Job Plan Procedure
topics.concepts: Cost Value, Exchange Value, Use Value, Esteem Value, Value = Function / Cost, 6-phase Value Engineering Job Plan (Information, Function Analysis, Creative, Evaluation, Development, Presentation).

topics.title: Break-Even Analysis (BEP)
topics.concepts: Fixed cost, variable cost, Contribution = Sales - Variable Cost, P/V Ratio = Contribution/Sales, BEP (units) = FC / (P - V), BEP (sales) = FC / (P/V ratio), Margin of Safety, Break-Even Chart.

topics.title: Cost-Benefit Analysis (CBA)
topics.concepts: Identification of costs and benefits, discounting, Benefit-Cost Ratio (BCR = Present value of benefits / Present value of costs), decision criteria BCR >= 1.

topics.title: Capital Budgeting Techniques
topics.concepts: Payback Period method, Net Present Value (NPV = PV of inflows - Initial Investment), Internal Rate of Return (IRR), comparison and decision rules.
